records.body: ### 项目地址 https://github.com/knsjd25/mini-tools.uk ### 类别 其它 ### 项目标题 Free Image Hosting: No-signup image-to-URL tool for Markdown, ### 项目描述 ## Project / Tool Name Mini-Tools Free Image Hosting ## Tool URL https://mini-tools.uk/upload?utm_source=github&utm_medium=self_recommendation&utm_campaign=free_image_hosting ## Repository / Introduction Page https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/github-readme-image-hosting ## Category Online Tool / Free Image Hosting / Image-to-URL Tool / Markdown Utility / Developer Productivity Tool ## Short Description Mini-Tools Free Image Hosting is a lightweight no-signup image hosting tool that helps users upload images and instantly convert them into direct image URLs. It is designed for developers, bloggers, technical writers, Markdown users, GitHub README authors, and forum users who need a quick way to generate image links. ## Why I Built It When writing a GitHub README, Markdown document, technical blog, tutorial, or forum post, a common problem is: > I have an image, but I need a direct image URL. Many image hosting platforms require registration, have complex dashboards, or are designed more like social albums than developer tools. Mini-Tools Free Image Hosting focuses on a simple workflow: 1. Open the page 2. Upload an image 3. Copy the direct image URL 4. Paste it into Markdown, HTML, GitHub README, blogs, or forums The goal is to make image-to-URL conversion fast, simple, and accessible without requiring users to create an account. ## Main Features - No-signup image hosting - Free image hosting for lightweight use cases - Image-to-URL conversion - Direct image URL output - Markdown image syntax - HTML image code - BBCode output - Useful for GitHub README screenshots - Useful for Markdown documents - Useful for technical blogs and forums - Suitable for documentation screenshots and tutorial images ## Output Examples Markdown: ![image](https://your-image-url.webp) HTML: BBCode: [img]https://your-image-url.webp[/img] ## Use Cases Mini-Tools Free Image Hosting can be used for: - GitHub README project screenshots - Markdown documentation images - GitHub Issues and Discussions - Technical blog images - Forum image sharing - Tutorial screenshots - Quick image-to-URL conversion - Lightweight image hosting - Documentation and knowledge base images ## Target Users This tool is useful for: - Developers - Open-source maintainers - Technical writers - Markdown users - Bloggers - Indie makers - Forum users - Documentation teams ## Keywords free image hosting, no-signup image hosting, image to URL, image-to-URL converter, Markdown image hosting, GitHub README image hosting, image URL generator, free image hosting API, direct image URL, developer image hosting tool. ## Future Plans Some planned improvements include: - Clearer copy buttons for Markdown, HTML, and BBCode - Upload history for recently generated image links - Better GitHub README and Markdown workflow support - More image format support - Optional lightweight image hosting API for developers - More documentation examples for README and blog use cases ## Why It May Be Useful Mini-Tools Free Image Hosting is not trying to replace advanced cloud storage platforms. Instead, it focuses on a very specific and common need: > Upload an image and quickly get a usable URL. This makes it useful for small documentation tasks, README screenshots, Markdown writing, blog publishing, forum sharing, and other lightweight image hosting workflows. ## One-line Summary Mini-Tools Free Image Hosting is a no-signup free image hosting tool that turns images into direct URLs and generates Markdown, HTML, and BBCode image links for developers and content creators. ### 亮点 - Free image hosting - No registration required - Image to URL conversion - Direct image URL output - Markdown image syntax - HTML image code - BBCode output - Suitable for GitHub README, Markdown docs, blogs, and forums - HTTPS supported - English interface available ### 示例代码 ```markdown ``` ### 截图或演示视频 _No response_

records.body:
### 项目地址

https://github.com/cosin2077/memo

### 类别

JS

### 项目标题

memo 是一个基于 CoALA 认知架构与最新现代认知科学实践的本地优先 AI Agent 记忆 SDK + CLI：原始对话可追溯，长期记忆可重建，Agent 可自动回忆，也可按需查证和迁移。

### 项目描述

> memo 是一个本地优先的 AI Agent 记忆 SDK + CLI：原始对话可追溯，长期记忆可重建，Agent 可自动回忆，也可按需查证和迁移。

## 简介

memo 为 AI Agent 提供**可追溯**、**可重建**、**可检索**、**数据掌控**的长期记忆能力。它把原始对话保存为 `MessageLog`，再通过异步 造梦💤 流程提取**事件记忆**、**语义知识**、**冲突变化**、**信念修正**和可选知识图谱。

SDK 提供极简 API：用 `addMessages` 写入单条/多条 message，用 `search/hydrate` 召回记忆；同时提供 `lookup_messages` / `query_knowledge_graph` tools，让 Agent 可以自主查证底层原文和知识关系。

CLI 则提供本地记忆操作台：可以导入 Claude Code / OpenAI 风格历史对话、触发 Dream 生成长期记忆、查看 Episodes / Knowledge、导出原始 `MessageLog` 备份，也可以生成给人类和其他 Agent 直接阅读的 `MEMORY.md`。


### 亮点


- **极简接入** — `pnpm add @memo-labs/sdk`，一行代码即可接入，无需部署服务
-  **认知科学驱动设计** — 基于 CoALA 认知架构与最新现代认知科学实践，将认知模型落地为可运行的 Agent 记忆系统
- **CLI 本地记忆操作台** — `memo info/import/dream/memories/export` 覆盖导入、造梦、检查、备份和迁移
- **Claude Code 开箱即用** — 一行导入 Claude 工程历史并生成长期记忆：`pnpm cli import --claude --all --user claude-code --dream`
- **Agent-readable MEMORY.md** — `memo export memory --user claude-code --output MEMORY.md`，把长期记忆交给 OpenClaw、Codex、Claude Code 或其他 Agent
- **五层记忆架构** — MessageLog 全量可审计、可溯源、可重建，异步造梦固化语义知识
- **两层回忆** — hydrate 自动注入 + LLM Tools 按需深度检索
- **唯一真理源 + 可重建** — MessageLog 保存全部原始对话，下游数据均可从中重建
- **原始数据可迁移** — 导出 `MessageLog` JSON，导入新实例后通过 Dream 重建事件记忆、语义记忆和可选图谱索引
- **近期情境与记忆卡片** — `<RECENT>` 总结当前专注事项，XML 记忆卡片描述用户/Agent 偏好、边界和上下文
- **证据分离水合** — verify 模式下原始证据与语义事实分开注入，可验证
- **Token 预算管理** — 贪婪装箱 + LLM 压缩，不浪费上下文窗口
- **惊奇度驱动更新** — 事实变更自动触发再造梦，记忆持续保鲜


### 示例代码

```markdown
例如：

import { MemoSDK } from "@memo-labs/sdk";
const memo = await MemoSDK.create({ userId: "user-demo-001" });
const session = await memo.startSession({ title: "技术学习会话" });
await session.addMessages([
    { content: "我想学习 TypeScript 高级类型", role: "user" },
    { content: "TypeScript 高级类型包括条件类型、映射类型、模板字面量类型等，建议从泛型开始学习。", role: "assistant" },
    { content: "请推荐一些学习资源", role: "user" },
    { content: "推荐《TypeScript 深入浅出》，重点掌握第 3-5 章的泛型和条件类型。", role: "assistant" },
    //...
]);
await session.dream();
const memoryContext = await session.search({
    query: "TypeScript 学习资源",
});
```
